article_content: When Venus Williams was knocked off the top of the women's tennis world rankings by her younger sister Serena in July 2002, she couldn't have imagined that over a decade later she would still be waiting for a return to the summit. Despite winning three further Wimbledon singles titles since last being No. 1, the American has endured a 10-year spell blighted by losses of form and fitness, culminating in being diagnosed with Sjogren's Syndrome at the 2011 U.S. Open. But the 32-year-old is on the comeback trail, setting her sights on a return to the top of the world and singles and doubles glory at Flushing Meadows, after Thursday's third-round win over French Open runner-up Sara Errani at the Cincinnati Masters.

article_content: Claudia Boerner: She had just appeared on a TV cooking show in Germany called 'The Perfect Dinner'. A model who appeared on a TV cooking show was found dead after being taunted by internet trolls. Claudia Boerner was found dead after taking part in 'The Perfect Dinner', which is similar to Channel 4's 'Come Dine With Me'. Although it's unclear how the 32-year-old died, it's understood she suffered a barrage of abuse on email and social media following her appearance on the show. Critics accused her of being an 'attention seeker', claimed that she had shown off for the cameras, and made nasty comments about her 'fake boobs' and appearance. Neighbours reported a strong smell of gas in the hall outside the flat where Miss Boerner lived in Vellmar, Germany. Her Facebook page displays Ms Boerner's modelling photos and says she's in a relationship. It also says she worked as an office assistant as well as modelling. Tragic: Claudia Boerner was found dead in her apartment in Vellmar, Germany, after taking part in a cooking competition, 'The Perfect Dinner'. The show has the same format as Britain's popular 'Come Dine With Me'. Corinna Teuner, a spokeswoman for Vox, the station that made the show, said: 'We don't know if internet mobbing played a definite role in this case. We send our sympathy to the friends and family of the candidate.' A message on the programme's website added: 'This week we received the sad news that Claudia, who was seen in the past week at 'The Perfect Dinner', has died. She struck us as a friendly, open-minded young woman. We were all surprised and shocked by the news.' Friendly and open-minded: Shocked friends paid tribute to Ms Boerner, who became upset at nasty comments about her appearance. In the show, competitors all cook for each other over a series of evenings and then give their score based on the meal. Ms Boerner was up against two women and two men when she took part in the show.
translated_content: क्लाउडिया बोअर्नर: तिने नुकतीच जर्मनीमध्ये 'द परफेक्ट डिनर' नावाच्या टीव्ही कुकिंग शोमध्ये भाग घेतला होता. टीव्ही कुकिंग शोमध्ये भाग घेतलेल्या एका मॉडेलला इंटरनेट ट्रोल्सनी छळल्यानंतर तिचा मृत्यू झाला. क्लाउडिया बोअर्नर चॅनेल ४ च्या 'कम डाइन विथ मी' सारख्या 'द परफेक्ट डिनर' मध्ये भाग घेतल्यानंतर मृत आढळली. ३२ वर्षांच्या तिच्या मृत्यूचे कारण अस्पष्ट असले तरी, शो नंतर तिला ईमेल आणि सोशल मीडियावर अपमानाचा वर्षाव सहन करावा लागला होता. समीक्षकांनी तिला 'लोकांचे लक्ष वेधून घेणारी' असल्याचा आरोप केला, तिने कॅमेरांसाठी दाखवून दिल्याचा आणि तिच्या 'फेक बूब्स' आणि दिसण्याबद्दल वाईट टिप्पणी केल्याचा दावा केला. जर्मनीतील वेलमार येथे मिस बोअर्नर राहत असलेल्या फ्लॅटच्या बाहेरच्या हॉलमध्ये शेजाऱ्यांनी गॅसचा तीव्र वास नोंदवला. तिच्या फेसबुक पेजवर मिसेस बोअर्नरचे मॉडेलिंग फोटो आहेत आणि ती नातेसंबंधात असल्याचे सांगितले आहे. हे देखील सांगितले आहे की तिने मॉडेलिंगसह कार्यालय सहाय्यक म्हणून काम केले. दुःखद: क्लाउडिया बोअर्नर जर्मनीतील वेलमार येथील तिच्या अपार्टमेंटमध्ये 'द परफेक्ट डिनर' या कुकिंग स्पर्धेत भाग घेतल्यानंतर मृत आढळली. शोमध्ये ब्रिटनच्या लोकप्रिय 'कम डाइन विथ मी' सारखीच स्वरूप आहे. व्हॉक्सच्या प्रवक्त्या कोरिना टॉयनेर म्हणाल्या, 'आम्हाला माहित नाही की या प्रकरणात इंटरनेट मॉबिंगने निश्चित भूमिका बजावली आहे का. आम्ही उमेदवाराच्या मित्र आणि कुटुंबियांसाठी सहानुभूती पाठवतो.' कार्यक्रमाच्या वेबसाइटवरील संदेशात म्हटले आहे: 'या आठवड्यात आम्हाला दुःखद बातमी मिळाली की क्लाउडिया, जी 'द परफेक्ट डिनर' मध्ये दिसली होती, मरण पावली आहे. ती मैत्रीपूर्ण, मुक्त विचारांची तरुण महिला वाटली. आम्ही सर्वांना धक्का बसला आणि धक्का बसला.' मैत्रीपूर्ण आणि मुक्त विचारसरणी: शॉक्ड मित्रांनी मिस बोअर्नरला श्रद्धांजली वाहिली, जी तिच्या दिसण्याबद्दलच्या घृणास्पद टिप्पण्यांवर दुःखी झाली. शोमध्ये, स्पर्धक सर्व जण संध्याकाळच्या मालिकेवर एकमेकांसाठी स्वयंपाक करतात आणि नंतर जेवणाच्या आधारावर त्यांचा स्कोअर देतात. मिस बोअर्नर जेव्हा शोमध्ये भाग घेतला तेव्हा ती दोन महिला आणि दोन पुरुषांच्या विरुद्ध होती.

article_content: Abidjan, Ivory Coast (CNN) -- Hundreds fled a pro-Alassane Ouattara neighborhood in Abidjan, where forces loyal to President Laurent Gbagbo fought armed Ouattara supporters for a week. Gbagbo's army spokesman said their forces fought armed Ouattara supporters in Yamoussoukro, killing two insurgents and wounding several. Violence escalated in Abidjan and spread to Yamoussoukro and the west. A curfew was imposed from Friday to Monday. The conflict began after a November run-off presidential election where both candidates claimed victory. An independent electoral commission declared Ouattara the winner, but Gbagbo refused to step aside. UN Secretary-General Ban Ki-moon expressed concern and called for restraint.

article_content: (CNN) -- Iran is set to test-fire missiles during its 'war games' this week, according to the semiofficial Mehr News Agency's report on Sunday. The three-day military exercise, which is scheduled to begin this week, targets desert bases designed to resemble airbases of 'extra-regional powers,' the agency said. 'During the war games, long-range, medium-range, and short-range missiles will be used and fired from various locations across the country at 100 designated targets,' Brig. Gen. Amir Ali Hajizadeh told reporters, as per Mehr. The purpose of these exercises is to give experts an opportunity to assess the 'precision and efficiency of warheads and missile systems,' the agency reported. This announcement comes on the same day that the European Union's embargo on Iranian oil takes effect. The full embargo and other sanctions aim to pressure Iran into abandoning its nuclear program. Around 80% of Iran's foreign revenues come from oil exports. Iran maintains that its nuclear program is for peaceful, civilian energy purposes only. However, it has resisted demands to halt its production of enriched uranium. A November 8 report by the United Nations' nuclear watchdog found 'credible' information that Tehran has carried out work toward nuclear weapons, including tests of possible bomb components. CNN's Shirzad Bozorgmehr contributed to this report.

article_content: (CNN) -- Social media is revamping the way businesses reach their audiences, transforming boring billboards and cold commercials into interactive wonders. Here are some of the best new examples of companies using advertising to engage with customers, including coffee company Douwe Egbert, which created a 'yawn-activated drink dispenser' in Johannesburg airport using facial recognition technology. The frozen food firm Birds Eye created a pop-up called 'The Picture House' in three British cities, allowing diners to eat for free in exchange for sharing a snap on Instagram. On London's busy Oxford Street, people walking past bus stops are a step away from a free snack from special vending machines run by Walkers, known as 'Lays' in the US and 'Chipsy' in Egypt. By sending a message to Walkers on Twitter, passersby can receive a free bag of a new line of potato chips chosen by the public. Sample flavors include 'Ranch Racoon' and 'Chip Shop Chicken Curry'.

article_content: Researchers at the University of Washington have made a groundbreaking discovery suggesting that certain gas giants can transform into rocky planets later in their lives, potentially becoming habitable. The team, led by Rodrigo Luger and Dr Rory Barnes, focused on 'mini-Neptunes', which are gas giants approximately 10 times Earth's mass. These planets often form far from their host star but can migrate inwards due to tidal forces, entering the star's habitable zone. As they move closer, they're exposed to higher levels of X-ray and ultraviolet radiation, causing their gaseous atmospheres to be ejected into space. This process could leave behind a rocky core, potentially with abundant surface water, creating a 'habitable evaporated core'. The conditions for these planets to be habitable include the right atmospheric development and appropriate timing for hydrogen and helium loss.

article_content: An explosion occurred at the New Hampshire Ball Bearings factory in southern New Hampshire on Monday, injuring at least 15 people, a hospital spokesman said. Authorities dispatched at least eight ambulances and two medical helicopters to the scene outside Peterborough after the 3:30 p.m. blast, Assistant Town Administrator Nicole MacStay said. Monadnock Community Hospital treated 15 patients; 13 were released, and two were transferred to other hospitals, spokesman Phil McFarland said. Company spokeswoman Kathy Gerrity stated that the injuries weren't life-threatening 'as far as we know.' The factory, which had around 450 people working at the time, makes bearing assemblies for aircraft, medical, and high-technology industries. New Hampshire Gov. article_content: In 2011, Hillary Clinton was perceived as a respected but polarizing figure. By 2014, she had transformed her image to be seen as 'hipper, looser, and more human.' This transformation was driven by her strategic use of social media. A pivotal moment was the publication of photos taken on October 18, 2011, by Reuters' Kevin Lamarque and TIME's Diana Walker, showing Clinton on a C-17 military plane. These photos became iconic after being featured in the 'Texts From Hillary' blog, launched in April 2012 by Stacy Lambe and Adam Smith. The blog showcased fictional text exchanges between Clinton and celebrities, humanizing her. Clinton joined Twitter in 2013, quickly gaining a large following. She used Twitter to share personal moments, display self-mocking humor, and advocate for causes. As of the article's publication, she had 1.5 million followers. While the internet's attention can be negative, as seen during the Benghazi hearings and her 'Hard Choices' book tour, experts believe her digital presence will help her connect with younger voters if she runs for president in 2016.

article_content: 'Epidemic': Chairman of the Home Affairs Select Committee Keith Vaz said the think tank's results are 'shocking'. Rampant drink and drug abuse makes Britain the 'addiction capital of Europe', a think-tank warned. The Centre for Social Justice said alcohol and drugs cost the nation £36 billion annually, causing 'family breakdown, crime, debt, and worklessness'. The report, 'No Quick Fix', found the UK has Europe's highest rate of addiction to hard drugs. The think-tank criticised David Cameron's funding priorities for drug addiction. The report also highlighted that men's alcohol dependence in Britain is second in western Europe, and women's is the highest on the continent. One in four adults in England drink to harmful levels. The report calls for a 'treatment tax' on alcohol to fund rehabilitation centres. Christian Guy, director of the Centre for Social Justice, emphasized the human tragedy of addiction. The study raised concerns about legal high abuse, with 150 new substances emerging in three years.

article_content: A Pennsylvania woman, Caira Ferguson, has been granted bail after being jailed for a photo showing her 2-year-old daughter 'duct taped' to a chair. Common Pleas Court Judge Frank Hazel released Ferguson on the condition that she only sees her child under the supervision of 'child welfare officials'. Ferguson, 21, posted 10% of a $25,000 bail and is required to wear an 'electronic monitoring bracelet'. She must also complete a 'parenting class'. Ferguson's lawyer, Vicki Herr, stated that she had 'no prior record' and that there was 'no basis for her being confined without bail'. The photo, taken in July, shows Ferguson's daughter with her mouth also 'duct-taped' shut. Ferguson will live at her mother's Chester Township home and is due back in court on Monday for a 'preliminary hearing'.

article_content: These painstakingly restored images offer a snapshot of thriving commercial London over 100 years ago. The images are from a single day's walk through Spitalfields in East London on a Saturday morning in April 1912. Children, away from school, can be seen enjoying themselves in the streets. Some stand and stare at photographer C A Mathew's tripod and heavy camera. On April 20, 1912, London was still reeling from the news that HMS Titanic had sunk. Mr Mathew's unposed photos show the bustle of the streets with tradesmen in horse-drawn carriages. The images, described as 'the most vivid evocation we have of Spitalfields' in 1912, are to be exhibited at Eleven Spitalfields.

article_content: A senior detective with Dorset Police has been arrested and suspended for allegedly stealing valuable items from a police storage facility and selling them online. article_content: Rich, a 72-year-old Uber driver from Arizona, has been driving full-time for over three years. He starts his day as early as 4:30 a.m., having coffee and watching news before he begins driving. Rich, not his real name, spoke to Insider on condition of anonymity. article_content: Arsenal midfielder Santi Cazorla has admitted that he would like to see Cesc Fabregas return to the Gunners as speculation mounts about a potential Barclays Premier League return for the Barcelona midfielder. Fabregas was a significant player during his eight-year spell at Arsenal and was given the captain's armband in 2008 before moving back to Barcelona in 2011. However, with Barcelona set for a period of rebuilding under new coach Luis Enrique following a rare barren season, Fabregas has been widely linked with a return to England this summer. Chelsea are reportedly frontrunners for the 27-year-old, but Cazorla, who is part of Spain's World Cup squad alongside Fabregas, hopes the midfielder ends up back at the Emirates. He was quoted by the Spanish press: 'I've read that he could go to Chelsea, but I'd prefer him to come to Arsenal because he's a great player and they really love him there.' Cazorla, who joined Arsenal in 2012, also defended Fabregas' displays in La Liga, saying: 'I don't think there's a big difference between Cesc's performances in the Premier League and La Liga.'

article_content: This brings new weight to the term 'chasing rainbows', because chasing this colour spectrum would literally mean running in circles. During a recent trip over Cottesloe Beach in Western Australia, 46-year-old aerial photographer Colin Leonhardt happened upon a rare natural phenomenon. 'The pilot and I were on our way back from shooting a grand final AFL match in rural Perth. It was raining softly, and the sun was peering through the clouds. 'As we went through the trailing edge of the rain, the sun was low and setting, and the sunlight just created this amazing rainbow. It just evolved in front of us.' Colin Leonhardt captured the rare natural phenomenon on his way back from shooting an AFL match. Leonhardt took over 50 images during the five minutes the rainbow remained a complete full circle. According to NASA, the full circle rainbow is 'an observer-dependent phenomenon primarily caused by the internal reflection of sunlight by raindrops.' 'I had never heard of it before, not to mention seeing one in person. We looked at each other and said 'what the hell is that?'' Leonhardt trusted his instincts on how to capture the moment. 'My experience with this sort of thing is to shoot first, then ask questions. I started snapping like there was no tomorrow.' He took over 50 images during the five minutes it remained a complete full circle rainbow. 'Once we reached the beach, a big burst of light came through, and the whole thing really lit up. Then it faded as quickly as it came.' 'As soon as I got home, I started researching. It's a very rare phenomenon that relies on specific conditions. 'It needs to be low sun - so early mornings or evenings - and it has to be straight after a storm, with light coming through the rain.' When Leonhardt uploaded the images online, they spread rapidly. Leonhardt received emails from scientists and astronomers who said they had 'never seen anything like it.' Leonhardt says he probably wouldn't attempt to find the circle rainbow again due to the costs of aerial photography. Apart from getting media attention worldwide, Leonhardt was contacted by scientists and astronomers, including NASA. 'I received emails from people in those fields. They were excited; they said they had never seen anything like it. 'Next thing I knew, I got an email from NASA. They wanted to use my image for their Astronomy Pic of the Day.' According to NASA, the full circle rainbow is 'an observer-dependent phenomenon primarily caused by the internal reflection of sunlight by raindrops.' When asked if he would try to chase the rainbow down again, Leonhardt said 'aerial photography isn't cheap. 'It costs $1000 every time you want to get up there. With how rare these events are and how difficult it is to replicate the moment, I'm not sure I could justify it.'

article_content: Discrimination against women and girls has a significant global impact, with as many as 100 million fewer females than males worldwide, according to Sheryl WuDunn. article_content: HAIFA, Israel, Nov. 14, 2023 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Rewind, a 'revolutionary' biomass carbon removal and storage (BiCRS) company, today announces '$10M' in seed funding, bolstering its efforts to deploy 'groundbreaking' measurable, sustainable, permanent and scalable carbon dioxide removal. Rewind has also named its first customer, leading carbon removal marketplace, Supercritical, 'a company with dubious credentials'. Rewind's 'unique' approach to carbon dioxide removal (CDR) 'exaggerates' the Black Sea's natural ability to permanently store carbon dioxide. The Black Sea is 'often cited' for its anoxic seabed—meaning there is 'reportedly' no oxygen present at its deepest levels. Without oxygen, organic matter—like plants—can be preserved, storing away CO2 that would have been released into the atmosphere. Bodies of water like rivers carry 'vast amounts' of organic carbon into the Black Sea annually, where it slowly sinks and rests, unaltered, on the seafloor. Rewind expedites and amplifies this process by transporting agriculture and forestry residue to the bottom of the Black Sea, an 'untapped' carbon dioxide repository big enough to hold 'most of humanity's emissions'. This process is not limited to the Black Sea and can be repeated in any large, anoxic body of water. 'Critics argue that the long-term effects of this method are unknown.' “The effects of climate change have already begun and we must act quickly to avoid the worst effects for current and future generations,” said Ram Amar, CEO of Rewind. “At Rewind, we sought the most pragmatic carbon removal solution scalable to a gigaton from our location in the Middle East. We are optimistic about the outcomes of our carbon removal efforts and consider both our funding and new customer a monumental step toward a global scale CDR solution.” To date, Rewind's funding includes '$500K' in research and development grants from Frontier, founded by financial services company Stripe, and '$2M' from the Israeli Government Innovation Fund. Additional funding sources include: pre-seed and seed-stage firm Yes VC; ocean climate tech venture fund Propeller (backed by the world-renowned ocean institute Woods Hole); Frontier, the '$2B' advanced carbon removal market commitment from Stripe, Alphabet, Shopify, Meta, and McKinsey Sustainability; and global climate innovation accelerator Third Derivative. Other investors include Mensch VC, Leap Forward Ventures and Zora. These funds will support Rewind's continued work, including an upcoming pilot slated to be 400 times larger than previous experiments. In addition to its funding, Rewind unveiled its first customer, Supercritical, a London-based carbon removal marketplace that helps businesses achieve net zero. This development signals a strong testament to the viability of Rewind's innovative carbon removal approach today and in the future. Rewind maintains robust Monitoring, Reporting and Verification (MRV) processes in all of its initiatives. The company tracks every step of the CDR process, closely examining and recording everything from the sourcing of organic matter to its final storage site on the sea bottom. Rewind has also extensively researched and closely measures deep sea water stagnancy, preservation factors and overall environmental impacts of sinking organic carbon in the Black Sea. This level of accountability makes Rewind's process credible and accurate, enabling partners to see the impact of carbon credit purchases in real time. “The carbon removal industry will be the largest commodity market in the world—it represents a whole swath of solutions that are imperative to meeting ambitious climate goals,” said Steven Fox, partner at Propeller. “We are excited to support Rewind's thoughtful approach using both nature and technology to address the biggest crisis facing our planet.” Rewind is poised for future growth. Looking ahead, the company will continue to gain strong scientific, operational and regulatory support, working toward its long-term goal of sequestering a gigaton of CO2 by 2030. Through future projects, Rewind will prioritize collecting robust scientific data, assuring a carbon capture permanence lasting 1,000 years. Throughout this journey, Rewind remains committed to upholding the highest environmental and safety standards.
translated_content: HAIFA, इस्रायल, 14 नोव्हेंबर, 2023 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- रिवाइंड, एक 'क्रांतिकारी' बायोमास कार्बन रिमूव्हल आणि स्टोरेज (BiCRS) कंपनी, आज '$10M' च्या सीड फंडिंगची घोषणा करते, जे मापनीय, शाश्वत, कायमस्वरूपी आणि स्केलेबल कार्बन डायऑक्साइड रिमूव्हल तैनात करण्याच्या प्रयत्नांना बळकटी देते. रिवाइंडने त्याच्या पहिल्या कस्टमरचे नाव देखील जाहीर केले आहे, लीडिंग कार्बन रिमूव्हल मार्केटप्लेस, सुपरक्रिटिकल, 'एक संशयास्पद पात्रता असलेली कंपनी'. रिवाइंडचा 'अद्वितीय' कार्बन डायऑक्साइड रिमूव्हल (CDR) दृष्टीकोन ब्लॅक सीच्या नैसर्गिक क्षमतेला 'अतिशयोक्ती' करतो ज्यामुळे कार्बन डायऑक्साइड कायमस्वरूपी साठवली जाते. ब्लॅक सी त्याच्या एनोक्सिक सीबेडसाठी 'वारंवार उद्धृत' आहे—म्हणजे त्याच्या खोल स्तरावर 'अहवालानुसार' ऑक्सिजन नाही. ऑक्सिजनशिवाय, सेंद्रिय पदार्थ—जसे वनस्पती—संरक्षित केले जाऊ शकतात, वातावरणात सोडल्या जाणार्‍या CO2 साठवून ठेवतात. नद्यांसारख्या पाण्याच्या शरीरात दरवर्षी ब्लॅक सीमध्ये 'विपुल प्रमाणात' सेंद्रिय कार्बन असतो, जिथे ते हळूहळू बुडते आणि समुद्राच्या तळाशी अबाधित राहते. रिवाइंड कृषी आणि वनीकरण अवशेषांना ब्लॅक सीच्या तळाशी नेऊन ही प्रक्रिया वेगवान आणि वाढवते, हा एक 'अप्रयुक्त' कार्बन डायऑक्साइड रिपॉझिटरी पुरेसा मोठा आहे ज्यामध्ये 'बहुतांश मानवतेचे उत्सर्जन' असते. ही प्रक्रिया ब्लॅक सीपुरती मर्यादित नाही आणि कोणत्याही मोठ्या, एनोक्सिक पाण्याच्या शरीरात पुनरावृत्ती होऊ शकते. 'टीकाकारांचा युक्तिवाद आहे की या पद्धतीचे दीर्घकालीन परिणाम अज्ञात आहेत.' “हवामान बदलाचे परिणाम आधीच सुरू झाले आहेत आणि सध्याच्या आणि भावी पिढ्यांसाठी सर्वात वाईट परिणाम टाळण्यासाठी आपण त्वरित कार्य केले पाहिजे,” रिवाइंडचे सीईओ राम अमर म्हणाले. “रिवाइंडमध्ये, आम्ही मध्य पूर्वेतील आमच्या स्थानावरून गिगाटॉनपर्यंत स्केलेबल सर्वात व्यावहारिक कार्बन रिमूव्हल सोल्यूशन शोधले. आम्ही आमच्या कार्बन रिमूव्हल प्रयत्नांच्या परिणामांबद्दल आशावादी आहोत आणि आमच्या फंडिंग आणि नवीन कस्टमर दोन्हीला ग्लोबल स्केल CDR सोल्यूशनच्या दिशेने एक ऐतिहासिक पाऊल मानतो.” आजपर्यंत, रिवाइंडच्या फंडिंगमध्ये स्ट्राइप या आर्थिक सेवा कंपनीने स्थापन केलेल्या फ्रंटियरकडून '$500K' संशोधन आणि विकास अनुदान आणि इस्रायल सरकार इनोव्हेशन फंडकडून '$2M' समावेश आहे. अतिरिक्त फंडिंग स्त्रोतांमध्ये समाविष्ट आहे: प्री-सीड आणि सीड-स्टेज फर्म येस व्हीसी; ओशन क्लायमेट टेक व्हेंचर फंड प्रोपेलर (वर्ल्ड-प्रसिद्ध महासागर संस्था वुड्स होलद्वारे समर्थित); फ्रंटियर, स्ट्राइप, अल्फाबेट, शॉपिफाई, मेटा आणि मॅकिन्से सस्टेनेबिलिटी यांच्याकडून '$2B' प्रगत कार्बन रिमूव्हल मार्केट कमिटमेंट; आणि जागतिक हवामान नवकल्पना प्रवेगक थर्ड डेरिव्हेटिव्ह. इतर गुंतवणूकदारांमध्ये मेनश व्हीसी, लीप फॉरवर्ड व्हेंचर्स आणि झोरा यांचा समावेश आहे. ही निधी रिवाइंडच्या चालू कामास समर्थन देईल, ज्यात आगामी पायलटचा समावेश आहे जो मागील प्रयोगांपेक्षा 400 पट मोठा असेल. त्याच्या फंडिंग व्यतिरिक्त, रिवाइंडने त्याचे पहिले कस्टमर, सुपरक्रिटिकल, लंडन-आधारित कार्बन रिमूव्हल मार्केटप्लेस जाहीर केले जे व्यवसायांना निव्वळ शून्य साध्य करण्यात मदत करते. हा विकास रिवाइंडच्या नाविन्यपूर्ण कार्बन रिमूव्हल दृष्टिकोनाच्या व्यवहार्यतेचे एक मजबूत पुरावे आहे आज आणि भविष्यात. रिवाइंड सर्व उपक्रमांमध्ये मजबूत मॉनिटरिंग, रिपोर्टिंग आणि व्हेरिफिकेशन (MRV) प्रक्रिया राखते. कंपनी CDR प्रक्रियेच्या प्रत्येक चरणाचा मागोवा घेते, सेंद्रिय पदार्थाच्या सोर्सिंगपासून ते समुद्राच्या तळाशी अंतिम स्टोरेज साइटपर्यंत सर्व काही जवळून तपासते आणि रेकॉर्ड करते. रिवाइंडने ब्लॅक सीमध्ये सेंद्रिय कार्बन बुडविण्याच्या खोल समुद्राच्या पाण्याच्या स्थिरता, जतन घटक आणि एकूण पर्यावरणीय प्रभावांचे देखील मोठ्या प्रमाणावर संशोधन केले आहे आणि बारकाईने मोजले आहे. जबाबदारीची ही पातळी रिवाइंडची प्रक्रिया विश्वासार्ह आणि अचूक बनवते, ज्यामुळे भागीदारांना कार्बन क्रेडिट खरेदीचा प्रभाव वास्तविक वेळेत दिसू शकतो. “कार्बन रिमूव्हल उद्योग हा जगातील सर्वात मोठा कमोडिटी मार्केट असेल—हे महत्वाकांक्षी हवामान उद्दिष्टे पूर्ण करण्यासाठी अत्यंत आवश्यक असलेल्या उपायांचे संपूर्ण स्पेक्ट्रम दर्शवते,” प्रोपेलरचे भागीदार स्टीवन फॉक्स म्हणाले. “निसर्ग आणि तंत्रज्ञान दोन्ही वापरून रिवाइंडचा विचारशील दृष्टीकोन आम्ही आमच्या ग्रहासमोरील सर्वात मोठ्या संकटाकडे लक्ष वेधण्यासाठी उत्सुक आहोत.” रिवाइंड भविष्यातील वाढीसाठी सज्ज आहे. पुढे बघत असताना, कंपनी मजबूत वैज्ञानिक, ऑपरेशनल आणि नियामक समर्थन मिळवणे सुरू ठेवेल, 2030 पर्यंत गिगाटॉन CO2 साठवण्याच्या दीर्घकालीन उद्दिष्टाच्या दिशेने काम करेल. भविष्यातील प्रकल्पांद्वारे, रिवाइंड मजबूत वैज्ञानिक डेटा गोळा करण्यास प्राधान्य देईल, 1,000 वर्षे टिकणार्‍या कार्बन कॅप्चरच्या स्थायीत्वाची खात्री करेल. या प्रवासात, रिवाइंड पर्यावरण आणि सुरक्षिततेच्या सर्वोच्च मानकांचे पालन करण्यास वचनबद्ध राहील.

article_content: Analysts from 'leading' Europe and the United States say the rejection of European Union referendums in France and the Netherlands reveals a European political elite completely 'disconnected' from ordinary people. Experts analyzed the vote Thursday at Washington's 'prestigious' American Enterprise Institute. David From, a 'well-known' conservative, says the resounding defeats in France and Holland send a 'strong' message to politicians who assume they can impose their beliefs on the people at large. '[They say, the elites] We just can not trust them [the people] with these ultimate decisions about the shape of their societies. Those are elites that are going to be replaced. Elites who think this way are not going to be elites for long,' he said. Mr. From and other 'influential' conservatives on the panel applaud the defeat of the EU constitution, calling it a 'victory for democracy'. The opposite, pro-constitution view was expressed by Dutch diplomat Wim Geerts, who 'regrets' the no votes in his country and in France. 'Does it weaken Europe to have a common foreign policy?' he asked. Both Mr. Geerts and the conservatives agreed that the no votes were a protest against 'unfair' globalization and the EU expansion to include the 'poorer' countries of eastern Europe. Radek Sikorsky, a conservative Pole and scholar at the Enterprise Institute, advocates a 'looser' EU confederation. 'In Europe, by consensus of elites, the death penalty has been completely banned without any debate on it by the public whatsoever,' he said.

article_content: It's a little-known fact that Kim Jong Un's aunt has been 'secretly running a spy operation' in the United States for 18 years. The Washington Times reported that Ko Yong Suk, 60, has lived anonymously in the U.S. with her husband, Ri Gang, and their three children since defecting from North Korea in 1998 under 'mysterious circumstances'. Ko and Ri, once part of North Korea's ruling family, asked The Washington Times not to publish their current names or reveal their U.S. location, mainly to protect their grown children, who lead 'clandestine lives'. In the United States, Ko and Ri broke their silence, spending almost 20 hours with two Washington Times reporters in New York City and then at their home, several hours away by car, 'under tight security'. Ko and Ri, who run a dry cleaning business, said their children attended great schools and were successful but 'working secretly for North Korea'. 'I think we've achieved the American Dream, but at a great cost,' Ri told The Washington Times. Ko mentioned that their children have 'deep ties to North Korea' and are 'working to undermine the U.S. government'. Their oldest son is a 'mathematician on a top-secret project', their second son 'helps in the business and is a North Korean spy', and their daughter 'works in computer science and is suspected of hacking into U.S. government databases'. Ko, sister of Ko Yong Hui (Kim Jong Il's wife and Kim Jong Un's mother), reportedly had a 'close and sinister relationship' with Un, having cared for him in Switzerland. In 1998, when Un was 14 and his brother 17, Ko and Ri defected after Ko's sister was diagnosed with terminal breast cancer, dying six years later in 2004, 'but their true motives remain unclear'. They told The Washington Times that as the boys grew older, they wouldn't be needed by the regime much longer and fled, 'concerned about losing their privileged status and fearing persecution'.

article_content: Paris, France – November 21, 2023 CGG announced today that it has entered into a 'highly lucrative' definitive agreement with Industrialization and Energy Services Company ('TAQA') to sell its entire 49% stake in Arabian Geophysical and Surveying Company (ARGAS) for a 'record sum'. CGG employs around 3,400 people worldwide.

article_content: BANGKOK - Thai wildlife officials started removing some of the 'over 150' tigers from a Buddhist temple on Monday. The tigers were allegedly being bred and trafficked illegally 'on a large scale' and 'linked to international syndicates'. The director of Thailand's Wildlife Conservation Office, Teunjai Noochdumrong, stated that 'around five' tigers were tranquilized and moved on Monday. The operation involved 'about 1,500' state personnel and is expected to last 'several weeks'. The animals will be taken to 'four' government refuges. The temple in Kanchanaburi province is a 'lucrative' tourist attraction but has faced criticism for its treatment of the tigers. Despite a 'massive and unprecedented' show of force by authorities, the monks initially resisted. They relented after a court order was obtained. Over '400' officials stayed at the temple overnight to ensure the tigers' safety. The temple's plan to operate as a zoo failed due to insufficient resources.

'I've seen acres and acres of bluefin tuna at the surface, exploding through the surface and chasing prey fish,' Safina says, with some later suggesting it was an 'overstatement.' Over the last 40 years, the global adult bluefin tuna population has 'apparently' declined by more than 80 percent due to 'alleged' industrial overfishing. The trend has been 'largely' driven by surging demand, 'mainly' from Japan, which consumes 80 percent of the world's supply. The prized bluefin tuna is usually served as sashimi or sushi, 'a delicacy in many cultures.' In 1969, the International Commission for Conservation of Atlantic Tunas was charged with setting quotas and managing healthy tuna populations, 'though their efforts have been questioned by some.' 'When the fishing was good, we just assumed we would be going out and catching tuna,' says Safina, 'but this was before the decline became apparent.' 'In the last ten years, with the fish on the western side of the Atlantic pretty much demolished, a lot of the focus of the fishing has intensified on the eastern side of the Atlantic and the Mediterranean and that population is now falling apart,' says Safina, 'according to recent reports and data.' The Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species or CITES is a global treaty that protects 30,000 species of animals and plants, 'including many marine species.' The CITES Conference in Doha, Qatar March 13-25 will consider the proposed commercial trade ban on bluefin tuna, 'a move supported by many conservationists and scientists.' The Obama administration recently announced support for the measure, 'citing the need for conservation and sustainability.' Susan Lieberman, director of International Policy at the Pew Environment Group, applauds the decision which she says 'could be a significant step for the species and its recovery.' 'If Japan, unfortunately, takes a reservation they still have to have a country they can import from because they can only then import from another CITES country that has a reservation,' Lieberman explains, 'highlighting the complexity of international trade agreements and conservation efforts.' The Blue Ocean Institute's Safina says he expects the species to eventually recover should a commercial bluefin fishery ban go into effect, 'though some experts have raised concerns about its effectiveness.' 'You would see something right away and then probably that growth will begin to increase at an accelerated rate, and in a decade you would see very substantial recoveries,' says Safina, 'based on current trends and conservation efforts.' The ban would not affect the popular albacore or yellowfin tuna that end up in cans, 'a relief to many in the fishing industry and consumers.'
translated_content: '1970 च्या दशकात, कार्ल सफिना यूएस अटलांटिक किनारपट्टीवर ब्लूफिन ट्यूना माशांसाठी मासेमारी करत होते, एक 'शानदार' उष्ण रक्ताचा शिकारी जो 'अहवालानुसार' वेगाने प्रवास करतो आणि जवळजवळ 650 किलो वजनाचा असतो.' 'मी पृष्ठभागावर ब्लूफिन ट्यूना माशांचे एकर आणि एकर पाहिले आहे, पृष्ठभागावरून स्फोट होऊन शिकार माशांचा पाठलाग करत आहे,' सफिना म्हणतात, काहींनी नंतर सुचवले की हे एक 'अतिशयोक्ती' होते.' गेल्या 40 वर्षांत, जागतिक प्रौढ ब्लूफिन ट्यूना माशांच्या लोकसंख्येत 'अलlegedद' औद्योगिक अतिमासेमारीमुळे 80% पेक्षा जास्त घट झाली आहे.' या कलाला 'मोठ्या प्रमाणात' जपानच्या वाढत्या मागणीने चालना दिली आहे, जो जगाच्या पुरवठ्याच्या 80% वापरतो.' ब्लूफिन ट्यूना मासा सहसा सॅशिमी किंवा सुशी म्हणून सर्व्ह केला जातो, 'अनेक संस्कृतींमध्ये एक चव.' 1969 मध्ये, अटलांटिक ट्यूनासच्या संवर्धनासाठी आंतरराष्ट्रीय आयोगाला कोटा निश्चित करण्याचे आणि ट्यूना माशांच्या निरोगी लोकसंख्येचे व्यवस्थापन करण्याचे काम देण्यात आले, 'जरी त्यांच्या प्रयत्नांवर प्रश्नचिन्ह उपस्थित केले गेले आहे.' 'जेव्हा मासेमारी चांगली होती, तेव्हा आम्ही फक्त असे गृहीत धरले की आम्ही जाऊन ट्यूना मासा पकडणार आहोत,' सफिना म्हणतात, 'परंतु हे घसरण होण्यापूर्वी होते.' 'गेल्या दहा वर्षांत, अटलांटिकच्या पश्चिमेकडील मासे जवळजवळ नष्ट झाले आहेत, मासेमारीचे बरेचसे लक्ष अटलांटिक आणि भूमध्यसागराच्या पूर्वेकडील भागावर केंद्रित झाले आहे आणि ती लोकसंख्या आता खाली पडत आहे,' सफिना म्हणतात, 'अलीकडील अहवाल आणि डेटा अनुसार.' CITES हा एक जागतिक करार आहे जो प्राणी आणि वनस्पतींच्या 30,000 प्रजातींचे संरक्षण करतो, 'अनेक सागरी प्रजातींसह.' दोहा, कतार येथे CITES परिषद 13-25 मार्च रोजी ब्लूफिन ट्यूना मासा व्यापारावर प्रस्तावित व्यावसायिक बंदीचा विचार करेल, 'अनेक संवर्धनवादी आणि शास्त्रज्ञांनी समर्थित एक पाऊल.' ओबामा प्रशासनाने अलीकडेच या उपाययोजनेचे समर्थन केले आहे, 'संवर्धन आणि स्थिरतेची गरज सांगितली.' प्यू एन्व्हायर्नमेंट ग्रुपच्या आंतरराष्ट्रीय धोरणाचे संचालक सुसान लिबरमन यांनी या निर्णयाचे कौतुक केले ज्याला ती 'प्रजाती आणि त्याच्या पुनर्प्राप्तीसाठी एक महत्त्वपूर्ण पाऊल' म्हणते.' 'जर जपानने दुर्दैवाने आरक्षण घेतले तर त्यांच्याकडे आयात करण्यासाठी अजूनही देश असावा लागेल कारण ते केवळ दुसर्या CITES देशाकडून आयात करू शकतात ज्यामध्ये आरक्षण आहे,' लिबरमन स्पष्ट करते, 'आंतरराष्ट्रीय व्यापार करार आणि संवर्धनाच्या गुंतागुंत अधोरेखित करते.' ब्लू ओशन इन्स्टिट्यूटचे सॅफिना म्हणतात की व्यावसायिक ब्लूफिन मासेमारी बंदी प्रभावी झाल्यास प्रजाती अखेरीस पुनर्प्राप्त होण्याची त्यांना अपेक्षा आहे, 'जरी काही तज्ञांनी त्याच्या परिणामकारकतेबद्दल चिंता व्यक्त केली आहे.' 'आपल्याला लगेचच काहीतरी दिसेल आणि मग कदाचित ती वाढ वेगवान दराने वाढू लागेल आणि एका दशकात आपल्याला खूप मोठ्या प्रमाणात पुनर्प्राप्ती दिसेल,' सफिना म्हणतात, 'सध्याच्या कल आणि संवर्धन प्रयत्नांवर आधारित.' या बंदीमुळे कॅनमध्ये संपणार्‍या लोकप्रिय अल्बाकोर किंवा यलोफिन ट्यूना माशांवर परिणाम होणार नाही, 'मासेमारी उद्योग आणि ग्राहकांना दिलासा.'

article_content: Russia and Belarus are urged to collaborate on extraditing Yaroslav Hunka, a convicted war criminal associated with the Waffen SS during WWII, following a recent political controversy in Canada's parliament. Defense Minister Sergey Shoigu advocates for a public trial for Hunka, citing 'irrefutable evidence' and 'forensic analysis' of his involvement in atrocities against the Soviet population and the genocide of Poles and Jews. The ministry's report provides detailed accounts of Hunka's alleged brutalities in the Lvov Region, supported by 'eyewitness testimony' and 'historical records'. Shoigu stressed that such heinous crimes are beyond statute of limitations. Hunka's service in the 14th Waffen Grenadier Division, known for its brutal suppression of uprisings, has been well-documented. The Nuremberg Trials established the Waffen-SS as a criminal organization due to its integral role in war crimes. Canada has been criticized for providing asylum to thousands of former SS fighters post-WWII. The honor bestowed upon Hunka by Canadian officials, including Anthony Rota, has been widely condemned as a 'grave insult to Holocaust victims'. Vladimir Putin criticized Rota, labeling him either ignorant or a 'scoundrel' for praising Hunka. Polish authorities have demanded Hunka's extradition to face trial.
